title: Makati eats: Former Thai hotpot gets rebrand from Ely Buendia, fellow musicians
summary: A former Thai hotpot in Makati is slowly becoming a go-to dining spot and watering hole for creatives, thanks to Eraserheads frontman Ely Buendia and fellow musicians Pat Sarabia and Audry Dionisio.
